moments.title: Back Bay National Wildlife Refuge
moments.text: Set aside in 1938 for wintering waterfowl, the refuge holds 4.5 miles of dunes and Atlantic beach, reached down Sandpiper Road from Sandbridge.

moments.title: Pungo
moments.text: Pungo's one stoplight, at Princess Anne and Indian River roads, sits south of the city's Green Line, which is there to keep this end of Virginia Beach rural.
